rejected.reason: The source mechanism (MP-N2) describes lift generation via asymmetric profile differential fluid acceleration — a causal structure that produces a net directional force perpendicular to flow. The target problem seeks drag reduction on an axisymmetric submarine hull at Re~10^8. Introducing asymmetry to create pressure gradients would generate unwanted lift/side forces, increase wetted area, and likely increase pressure drag and structural complexity, contradicting the drag-reduction goal. The abstract principle of 'differential acceleration for net force' does not map to drag minimization on a volume-constrained axisymmetric body; no plausible translation preserves the causal structure while meeting target constraints.
